# Machines & Cloud

> Stop losing jobs to the shop that answered first. Machines & Cloud builds an AI front desk for Houston home service companies (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, cleaning): it answers calls, texts, website chat, and Angi, Thumbtack, or Google Local Services leads within a minute, states only published fees, books the visit into the owner's calendar with reminders and on-the-way texts, and follows up on reviews, open quotes, quiet leads, and payments. Three plans by call minutes, setup included, no setup fee, first 7 days free, no contract: Starter $99 a month (150 minutes, 500 texts), Growth $249 a month (600 minutes, 1,500 texts, lead platforms, follow-up texts, Jobber or Housecall Pro), Pro $449 a month (1,500 minutes, 5,000 texts, campaigns, custom rules, weekly report). Over the included amounts: $0.35 a minute, $0.03 a text. Founder led, Houston based.
